title: Scoped common-core obstruction for an onsite-dressed first-passage coefficient
question: Can the exact Q3 onsite-plus-one-spatial-bond second response coefficient be bounded uniformly by a source Weyl position seminorm that grows only linearly in the translation amplitude?

model.source_site: one scalar source coordinate q with the other seven internal Q3 coordinates set to zero in the leading source-degree slice
model.target_site: one spatial neighbor r coupled by the harmonic bond -c q r
model.common_core: polynomial CCR core multiplied on the right by W_a; the identity is coefficientwise before any representation-specific norm estimate

exact_identity.potential_second_response: partial_r(Delta_a(q,r)^2)=cG a^5/2-2cG q a^4+3cG q^2 a^3+(-2cG q^3+2c^2 r)a^2
exact_identity.kinetic_boundary: The p^2 source commutator vanishes and the kinetic contribution cannot create an a^5 coefficient in the target p_r commutator; the displayed a^5 term is the exact potential-potential coefficient.

scoped_verdict: The coefficient-level common-core target has degree five in a while the declared source position seminorm is degree one. Therefore no source-uniform first-passage coefficient estimate of this form can hold on a class containing these Weyl translates with only linear source growth. This removes one-sided critical energy normalisations of that specific kind from the candidate tournament.
conditional_operator_consequence: If a representation contains translated compact wave packets with K^(1/2)-energy O(a^2), the same polynomial identity gives a one-sided K^(-1/2) response lower bound of order a^3, versus an O(a) source seminorm; hence the ratio is unbounded. This conditional wave-packet consequence is not promoted to a no-go for every analytic, Frechet, state-weighted, or modular topology.
open_after_test: frequency-profiled analytic or Frechet source weights growing at least as fast as the coefficient
symmetric or state-weighted estimates with cancellation not visible coefficientwise
the actual volume-uniform Q3 factorial expansion and two-orientation response
exhaustion Cauchy, common alpha, KMS, ground/GNS gap, continuum and Pre-A

adversarial_review.check: Only the leading scalar source-degree slice is used; no claim is made that the slice is an invariant full Q3 dynamics.
The source kinetic commutator is zero and kinetic terms cannot produce the displayed a^5 coefficient in the target p_r commutator.
The exact algebraic identity is not silently promoted to a representation-independent norm theorem; the wave-packet implication is stated conditionally.
The obstruction targets only linear-source one-sided critical energy normalisation; analytic/Frechet and state-weighted alternatives remain open.
No canonical TECT production map, heat_root_incidence field or A1/R-192 owner is supplied.
R213 checks only the rational polynomial identity and fixture arithmetic.

scope.closed: Exact coefficient-level obstruction for the declared common-core source-normalised critical route.
scope.not_closed: The full Q3 dynamics, all-bond Trotter limit, actual factorial path expansion, projected Duhamel locality, common alpha, KMS, ground state, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A remain open.

next_action: Test a source-weighted analytic/Frechet or state-weighted first-passage norm whose declared growth absorbs the a^5 coefficient, and require a genuine two-orientation volume-uniform recurrence before any QFT promotion.
no_overclaim: This package is a scoped route obstruction. It does not prove nonexistence of Q3 dynamics, reject every critical topology, close the Q3 factorial expansion, establish a thermodynamic QFT, or supply the TECT production dynamics.
